prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Full bleed story screen intro redesign: Redesign the story intro screen with a full bleed layout and playful pet mascot to boost initial engagement.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Meet Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Bring a charming virtual friend right onto your workspace desktop.", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "action": "next"}]}}
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Interactive welcome splash screen: Add a new welcome splash screen before story to set expectations and introduce pet choices.
   config: {"_order": ["new_welcome_splash", "story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_welcome_splash": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Welcome to Desktop Pets", "body": "Your new virtual companion is ready to be discovered.", "button_label": "Get Started", "components": [{"type": "image", "asset": "asset:welcome_pet", "style": "large"}]}}
2: [choose_path, hint] Choose path screen helper hint: Display a clear hint on the choose path screen explaining the difference between premade and custom pets.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Select premade pets for instant setup or custom pet to upload your own photos."}}
3: [sign_in, notification] Sign-in progress indicator and notification toggle: Enable progress bar and background notification toggle on the sign-in screen.
   config: {"sign_in": {"show_progress": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Signing in syncs your pet state safely across sessions."}}
4: [adoption, redesign] Carousel layout redesign for pick friend screen: Redesign the pick friend screen into a dynamic carousel layout with enlarged live pet previews.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Select Your Ideal Companion", "components": [{"type": "preview", "style": "large"}]}}
5: [adoption, new_flow] Guided custom pet photo upload flow: Upgrade photo upload screen with a photo picker tool and tip carousel to ensure high photo quality.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Upload Clear Pet Photos", "body": "Use clear lighting and front-facing pet photos for best generation results.", "components": [{"type": "photo_picker", "style": "rounded"}, {"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "subtle"}]}}
6: [adoption, copy] Adoption certificate confirmation button copy update: Update adoption certificate screen headline and action button label for clearer step progression.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "body": "Your pet choice is finalized. Proceed to prepare its desktop home!", "button_label": "Proceed to Desktop"}}
7: [home, wait_info] Generation timer and progress display on waiting screen: Add an estimated time display, progress bar, and automatic tip delay to the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15, "components": [{"type": "timer", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "progress", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [home, redesign] Spotlight layout redesign for desktop waiting screen: Redesign waiting screen with a spotlight layout featuring an animated pet status indicator.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Setting Up Desktop Workspace", "body": "Your pet companion is being placed on your desktop. It will appear momentarily!", "components": [{"type": "animation", "style": "playful"}]}}
9: [finish, copy] Home intro desktop controls copy update: Update home intro copy with clear desktop interaction instructions and tray icon hints.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "body": "Drag to move your pet around screen. Right click to access pet actions and settings.", "hint": "Minimize or manage your pet anytime via the system tray icon."}}

Adds a valid onboarding welcome screen without omitting any required steps.
Adds a helpful hint to choose path while preserving the options to adopt or make a custom pet.
Enhances the sign-in screen with progress and notification options within allowed onboarding rules.
Redesigns the pick friend screen into a carousel layout while preserving pet selection functionality.
Upgrades the photo upload flow with tools and tips while retaining its required job.
Updates text on the adoption certificate screen without removing required functionality or stamp.
Adds real wait progress and estimation indicators to the waiting screen as allowed by Rule 4 and Rule 5.
Redesigns waiting screen while continuing to convey that the pet is being prepared.
Updates home intro copy with desktop usage instructions within onboarding boundaries.
